name: Pecca Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Pecca Group Berhad 主要通过多项谅解备忘录推进航空与铁路领域的合作探索，包括与 Betamek Research 就 In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) 和 Passenger Information Entertainment System (PIES) 进行初步讨论，以及与 MARii 持续参与汽车智能制造项目。Pecca Leather 完成了 Auto-SMART 评估并获 Level 3 (1-Star Badge)。此外，公司宣布了截至2027财年的首次中期股息。
overview_en: In 2026, Pecca Group Berhad mainly advanced collaboration exploration in aviation and rail through several memoranda of understanding, including preliminary discussions with Betamek Research on In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) and Passenger Information Entertainment System (PIES), and continued participation in automotive smart manufacturing programmes with MARii. Pecca Leather completed the Auto-SMART assessment and was awarded Level 3 (1-Star Badge).

segments.name: 航空产品
segments.note: 与 Betamek Research 就航空 In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) 系统及铁路 PIES 解决方案进行合作探索，尚未达成具体项目或最终协议。
segments.note_en: Exploring collaboration with Betamek Research on aviation In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) systems and rail PIES solutions; no specific project or definitive agreement has been finalised.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 双方将继续探索和评估潜在合作领域，尚未敲定具体项目、商业安排或最终协议，合作未取得重大进展。
actions.text_en: Both parties will continue to explore and evaluate potential areas of collaboration; no specific project, commercial arrangement or definitive agreement has been finalised, and there has been no material development.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 双方在年初通过一系列讨论和工作层接触继续评估合作机会，主要聚焦航空板块的 IFE 系统，并就铁路板块的 PIES 解决方案进行了初步讨论。
actions.text_en: Both parties continued to evaluate collaboration opportunities through discussions and working-level engagements, primarily focused on IFE systems in the aviation segment, with preliminary discussions on PIES solutions in the rail sector.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: PASSB 与 Betamek Research 继续工作层讨论，重点完善航空和铁路板块的商业策略，包括 IFE 和 PIES 的初步定位。
actions.text_en: PASSB and Betamek Research continued working-level discussions focused on refining commercial strategy for aviation and rail segments, including preliminary positioning of IFE and PIES.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: PASSB 与 Betamek Research 于2025年10月至11月举行三次联合头脑风暴会议，探讨航空 IFE 和铁路 PIES 解决方案的联合商业计划。
actions.text_en: PASSB and Betamek Research held three joint brainstorming sessions in October and November 2025 to explore a joint business plan for aviation IFE and rail PIES solutions.

segments.name: 汽车产品
segments.note: Pecca Leather 参与 MARii 的 Auto-SMART 项目并获 Level 3 (1-Star Badge)，同时参加 GATE 展会以接触潜在业务伙伴。
segments.note_en: Pecca Leather participated in MARii's Auto-SMART programme and was awarded Level 3 (1-Star Badge), and attended the GATE expo to engage potential business partners.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Pecca Leather 于2026年5月13日完成 Auto-SMART 现场评估，项目于2026年7月13日结束，获颁 Level 3 (1-Star Badge)。
actions.text_en: Pecca Leather completed the Auto-SMART on-site assessment on 13 May 2026; the programme concluded on 13 July 2026 and PLSB was awarded Level 3 (1-Star Badge).

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Pecca Leather 在获得 MARii 供应商竞争力等级 Level 5 后，获邀参加计划于2026年5月举行的 Automotive Smart Manufacturing Badge (Auto-SMART) 项目。
actions.text_en: After obtaining Level 5 in MARii's Supplier Competitiveness Level, Pecca Leather was offered the opportunity to participate in the Automotive Smart Manufacturing Badge (Auto-SMART) programme scheduled for May 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Pecca Leather 代表受邀参加 MARii 于2025年11月12日至14日在吉隆坡会议中心举办的 Global Automotive and Technology Expo (GATE)，通过 GATE Connect 接触潜在业务伙伴。
actions.text_en: Pecca Leather representatives were invited to participate in MARii's Global Automotive and Technology Expo (GATE) held at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre from 12 to 14 November 2025, engaging potential business partners through GATE Connect.
